notes: **2026-08-30** — (branch `ci/minutes-diet`, off master 6c8f1401; no schema change) — **CI CUT FROM 6 JOBS TO 1 SO THE REPO CAN STOP FLIPPING PUBLIC.** The repo was going public for a few minutes per merge purely to make Actions minutes free (public = unlimited; private = 2,000/mo on Free). MEASURED FIRST, from the Actions API over 2026-07-31..08-30 (417 runs, per-job wall clock, each job billed rounded UP to the whole minute — reconciles to within 2.3% of the billing API's 6,256 min for August): Test 1,603 · E2E 736 · Type Check 1,172 · Lint 1,152 · Security Audit 949 = **5,612 min/mo = 2.8x the Free allowance.** ⚠️ The `/timing` endpoint returns billable=0 for every one of those runs — that is the public-repo discount, NOT zero usage; compute from job `started_at`/`completed_at` instead. THE BIGGEST LINE ITEM WAS NOT A CHECK: `npm ci` measured 75s inside EACH of five jobs, five times per run, plus five job setups each rounding up to a full billed minute. So lock-integrity + bug-scan + lint + type-check + test + security-audit are now ONE `verify` job, one install, running the literal `npm run verify`. ⚠️ The lockfile validator keeps its PRE-install placement as a STEP (an incoherent override kills `npm ci` itself, so a post-install gate never runs on the case it exists to explain) — the job boundary was never the point, the ordering was. **`verify` no longer runs on the master push** (only PR + dispatch): master is a squash of a rebased, already-verified tree, and Railway's Dockerfiles run `nest build`/`next build` for real, so a type error fails the DEPLOY. Dropped `--coverage` (no `coverageThreshold` is configured anywhere — it gated nothing) and its artifact upload. Dropped the Postgres+Redis services from the test path: **not one of the 181 api specs constructs a PrismaClient or reads DATABASE_URL**, they all mock at the module boundary, so 23s of "Initialize containers" per run served a single 4s check — that check moved to NEW `db-migrations.yml`, `paths:`-filtered to `apps/api/prisma/**`. `prisma db push` deleted outright (it set up a database no test read). `nightly.yml`'s cron COMMENTED OUT — dead since 2026-08-20 (0-step billing reds) and a ~330 min/mo landmine the moment billing is healthy. **LOCAL GATE: `npm run verify` no longer nests `npm run`.** ⚠️ MEASURE GATE TIMINGS ON AN IDLE BOX — the first pass here was taken under load and overstated everything by ~3x. Clean numbers, 3 interleaved rounds: warm gate **39.4s → 30.0s median** (~24%). The mechanism: `npm run` with NO ARGS (it only lists scripts) costs **7-9s** of npm startup on this Windows box vs 0.7s for `node -e ""`, and the old chain paid that three times (outer + 2 nested); the new one pays it once. Under saturation the same npm startup measured ~27s and the old chain 94.5s — so the win scales with how busy the box is, which is when it matters. ⚠️ Editing root `package.json` busts ALL 28 task caches (globalDependencies working as designed) — the very next run is a full cold build, measured 15m14s. ⚠️ That cold run ALSO reproduced the host-saturation false RED: `@routeflow/api#test` died with a bare `exited (1)` and NO jest report; re-run direct on a quiet box gave **181 suites / 3,148 tests, all passing**. Believe the direct re-run, never the bare exit code. `.husky/pre-push` gains a verified-tree fast path keyed on `HEAD^{tree}`, recorded in `.git/rf-verified` ONLY when the working tree is clean (verify inspects files on DISK, so with uncommitted edits a pass does not describe the pushed commit). It is local-only and CI does NOT trust it — a Windows pass is not proof for ubuntu (case-sensitive paths, separators, platform-gated deps), which is exactly what CI's one Linux job is for. ⚠️ Branch protection is unavailable on Free+private (403), so CI is NOT a required check and renaming jobs broke no gate. RESIDUAL: at August's volume the projection is ~2.2-2.5k min/mo, still ABOVE the 2,000 allowance — E2E on every master push (~13 billed min × ~82-102 pushes) is the remaining lever, and `playwright.config.ts`'s `workers: CI ? 1 : 2` is the biggest untaken win. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
